workflows.title: Service assembly, public probes, and preflight
agent_tools: None for HTTP handlers; A2UI catalog builder and Cosmos connection probe
Optional learner-memory lifespan worker, startup token-usage reconciliation daemon, research executor
permissions: No caller authentication on root, docs, catalog, health, or explicit OPTIONS
Configured credentialed CORS is not authorization; OPTIONS performs no domain mutation
state_changes: HTTP handlers have no intentional domain writes; process-local clients, caches, directories and executor configuration may initialize
Startup reconciliation writes Cosmos usage events and watermark; optional memory worker persists its own state
Shutdown signals workers, cancels queued research, closes async credentials; registered shutdown callback closes file processor
success: GET / redirects to configured frontend; GET /docs serves Swagger; GET /api/a2ui/catalog.json serves widgets
GET /api/chat/health checks Cosmos; GET /api/teacher-dashboard/health returns static status; OPTIONS /api/teacher-dashboard/logging-agent/chat/stream returns an empty object
create_app includes the completed registry and lifecycle
failure_retry: Missing required settings can prevent startup; Cosmos probe failure is 503
Memory shutdown waits up to 30 seconds; executor shutdown does not guarantee in-flight remote cancellation
General Azure/exception handlers can expose exception text as 400/500; no health retry contract
Startup reconciliation is one daemon run, not a periodic job or distributed lock

workflows.title: Microsoft sign-in and invite promotion
agent_tools: None; MSAL EntraAuth PKCE, IdentityService admission, and HS256 application-session helpers
permissions: Matching pending OAuth state, provider completion, user identifier and email-matched profile/invite
Reject conflicting provider; existing profile is not explicitly checked for active status
state_changes: Process-local pending flow is consumed
Promotion writes users_v1 with invited status and marks invited_users_v1 promoted; student names are pseudonymized
Secure HttpOnly SameSite=None browser session cookie is issued
success: GET /auth/login redirects to Microsoft; GET /auth/callback establishes application session and redirects to frontend callback
Promotion is separate from onboarding completion
failure_retry: Provider, directory and callback failures redirect to auth errors, sometimes including exception descriptions
Lost/consumed process-local state requires restarting login; no cross-worker flow store
Promotion writes are not transactional; no idempotency-key or cancellation contract

workflows.title: Google sign-in and availability reporting
agent_tools: None; GoogleAuth authorization-code PKCE, token exchange/userinfo, IdentityService admission and application JWT
permissions: Matching local state, code exchange, email/profile-or-invite presence, provider-conflict checks
No explicit active-profile or route-level email_verified check; status endpoint is public
state_changes: Pending verifier/state is process-local and consumed
Invite promotion persists profile/invite records; browser receives shared session cookie
Current ApplicationSettings requires Google client ID/secret even though handlers retain a not-configured branch
success: GET /auth/google/login and /auth/google/callback perform sign-in; GET /auth/google/status reports whether GoogleAuth exists
Successful callback redirects to frontend without a JWT in the URL
failure_retry: Errors redirect to frontend auth; token/userinfo requests have 30/15-second timeouts
No exchange retry loop; state is consumed before exchange and restart loses it
Restart login rather than replaying a callback; no transactional promotion rollback

workflows.title: Session display and logout
agent_tools: None; IdentityService session_profile, JWT verification and session transport; service_errors maps domain errors to HTTP status
permissions: GET /auth/me verifies cookie-preferred JWT with bearer fallback, but does not reload profile/status
POST /auth/logout has no caller-auth requirement
state_changes: Identity read changes no domain state
Logout deletes browser cookie, not issued JWTs or provider sessions
Cookie lifetime is fixed at seven days while JWT expiry is configurable
success: auth_me returns token identity claims; auth_logout returns status ok
failure_retry: Missing, invalid or expired token returns 401
Repeated logout is harmless cookie deletion; no token revocation/refresh/retry/cancellation contract

workflows.title: Directory listing, invitations, editing, and removal
agent_tools: None; IdentityService checks, DirectoryService policy and CosmosDirectoryRepository adapter to existing persistence helpers; no invitation-email worker
permissions: Listing verifies JWT and pseudonymizes non-admin other users except super-admin view; IDs and organization data remain
Writes require email-resolved admin or configured super-admin; no active-user dependency
PATCH restricts granting admin but not all revocation; POST role is not restricted by the same super-admin grant check
DELETE protects configured super-admin and limits removal of other admins to super-admin
state_changes: Creates invites or appends affiliation in invited_users_v1/users_v1; PATCH writes target invite/profile
Removal deletes profile or invite, not all chats/assets/JWTs
Pseudonym shuffle is response-local and seeded by caller email
success: GET/POST /api/directory list/invite; PATCH/DELETE /api/directory/{user_id} edit/remove
Invite reports new/existing/affiliation-added with 201/200
failure_retry: 401/403/404 where checked; partial query failures can produce partial directory results
Invite deduplication is read-then-write, not race-safe; many blank fields cannot clear existing values
No multi-record transaction, durable retry, idempotency key or cancellation

workflows.title: Active affiliation and organization-label maintenance
agent_tools: None; IdentityService checks, DirectoryService workflow and Cosmos adapter/profile/label/onboarding helpers

No active-profile check
state_changes: Switch persists activeAffiliation and top-level institute/department/role/college
Bulk operations update top-level C1/C2 label fields, not nested affiliations or department entities
Onboarding-progress read changes no domain state

POST /api/directory/institutes/{rename,delete} and /departments/{rename,delete} return counts
GET /api/directory/onboarding-progress compares non-promoted invites and active profiles, excluding the promoted-but-invited gap
failure_retry: 401/403 or 400 for invalid index/blank required labels
Bulk operations can partially complete; stale affiliation arrays can later restore old labels
Count failures yield zeros/done false; no transaction, retry or cancellation contract

workflows.title: Legacy profile and onboarding persistence
agent_tools: None; Cosmos profile helpers offloaded to threads
permissions: No caller/ownership check on GET, PUT or DELETE /api/user/{user_id}
Path user_id selects the profile; separate learner-profile authorization does not apply

Affiliations are preserved but arbitrary extra profile fields are not; agent-list cache invalidates
Deletion removes profile only; no browser-local or related-data cleanup
success: GET returns profile or successful null; PUT upserts and returns profile; DELETE returns boolean
failure_retry: Storage errors may be 500 or helper-level null
PUT is an upsert with timestamp changes, not an explicit-clearing or concurrent-update protocol
No idempotency key, retry, rollback or cancellation contract

workflows.title: Department entities and membership lists
agent_tools: None; Cosmos department and profile helpers
permissions: No caller/admin check despite admin-only comments
Existence/request-model checks are not ownership or role authorization
state_changes: Department documents persist; deletion marks inactive
Membership mutates a profile departments array, independently of directory affiliation strings
No browser-local state changes

GET/POST department members, DELETE a member, and GET /api/users/{user_id}/departments manage/read associations
Repeated add/remove recognizes already-present/absent membership; lists show active departments
failure_retry: 409 for checked existing creation ID; 404 where missing entity/user is checked
Create check/write is not atomic; inactive departments can retain membership references
No transaction, application retry or cancellation contract

workflows.title: Compatibility builder and specification conversations

AIProjectClient conversations/responses; referenced remote definition selects model
permissions: No caller, teacher-role, course-access or conversation-ownership checks
state_changes: Start creates remote Foundry conversation; step appends turn
No durable local job/course write; session is unused and CCA vector-store value is only returned
success: POST /api/cca/start and /step return builder reply with final JSON fence removed
POST /api/caca/start and /step return full specification-agent reply
Compatibility thread_id is the new conversation ID, not a provisioned course
failure_retry: 400 for missing opening/thread/reply; clients close in finally
Repeated starts or steps can duplicate conversations/turns
No request retry, idempotency key, rollback or cancellation contract

workflows.title: Name checks, definitions, tools, and platform diagnostics

permissions: check_agent_name and list_platform_agents have no caller check
Both get_agent_tools declarations and get_agent_details require active TA access
state_changes: No intentional remote writes; client/credential state is process-local

check_agent_name has two registered callables; get_agent_tools has two matching-shape paths with different parameter/response names
First registered matching route wins; Python name rebinding does not remove older registrations
failure_retry: 404 for missing details; adapter/SDK errors can become 400/500
GET /api/platform/agents omits required AgentCreator model_deployment and also assumes a mapping where list_agents returns a list
No retry/cancellation contract; diagnostics are not a verified live inventory

workflows.title: Instruction, tool, and version maintenance

course-agent-creation-agent via call_meta_agent_for_prompt; unify_agent_prompts for regeneration

state_changes: Persists remote versions/tools/instructions
Regeneration best-effort updates Cosmos description/context, setup Blob/local backup and caches

POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/update accepts model/instructions or no-ops; PUT /api/agents/{agent_name} reports new version
POST regenerate-prompt calls one specification agent and preserves prior starters when none generated

failure_retry: Malformed meta-agent JSON can fall back to raw instructions; post-update metadata/setup errors are non-fatal
400/404/500 vary by route; repeated writes create versions
No transactional rollback, idempotency key, automatic retry or cancellation contract

Direct validates name/kind and model allowlist; simple course creation does not apply the same allowlist

POST /api/agents/create-course ensures shared Search and creates a session-filtered named agent
failure_retry: Direct conflict 409/creation error 400; simple pipeline failure 500
Success can lack metadata/optional capabilities; these are not durable creation jobs

workflows.title: Setup metadata and local compatibility backup

workflows.title: Compatibility manage-code checks

permissions: Both routes require TA editor first; a code does not enroll learners or grant initial course access
GET checks supplied requester_id for creator/admin but does not bind it to authenticated actor
state_changes: Verification writes none; GET can generate and persist a missing code and timestamp

failure_retry: 400 missing code, 403 mismatch/requester restriction, 404 missing metadata

workflows.title: Best-effort Teaching Assistant teardown

permissions: TA editor dependency must load metadata and authorize before deletion
state_changes: Attempts chats/messages, agent metadata, hosted memory, legacy learning states, Foundry agent/local config, local setup and session material deletion

failure_retry: Many failures are logged and ignored; AgentCreator.delete_agent false is not inspected
Local permission errors have bounded retries; no durable teardown ledger or rollback

workflows.title: Compatibility Search attachment to an existing agent

Recreate does not reset ensured cache; cached ensure can skip rebuilding deleted resources
Multi-status deletion does not prove all items deleted; no exhaustive cleanup, atomicity, durable retry or cancellation
